title: Yea, I Will Extol Thee
description: Yea, I Will Extol Thee in Tonic Solfa to BEMERTON, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: James Montgomery wrote these words. They were printed in the supplement of the 1866 edition of A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1866), as hymn 549, “I Will Extol Thee, O Lord!”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sixes and Fives (6.5.6.5), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to BEMERTON; any other Sixes and Fives tune fits them as well.
underlay: Yea, I will ex-tol Thee, Lord of Life and light! For Thine arm up-held me, Turned my foes to flight.

lines: And bring me from the grave.

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: James Montgomery died in 1854.
credits: Words by James Montgomery (1771–1854), public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1866); set to BEMERTON by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
